groups.description:
Greeting commands.

Exercise: top-level group, two commands, the bound and the

commands.description:
Drop and recreate the database from scratch.

## Examples


- Reset interactively:

- toolr db reset

- Reset without prompting (CI):

- toolr db reset --yes
